sources.title: Introducing Toast 1
sources.evidence: The August 13, 2026 announcement identifies Toast 1 as Mixedbread's first specialized search agent, immediately available through its API. It describes evidence gathering and backend-agnostic retrieval, but gives no parameter count or neural architecture.

sources.title: Models
sources.evidence: The exact toast-1 card names Toast 1, specifies text input and text output, and describes knowledge-intensive questions, multi-step retrieval, evidence synthesis, and function calling. The rounded context label is 131K.

sources.title: Build Your Own Harness
sources.evidence: The Toast 1 guide explicitly states that thinking was disabled during training and is disabled in serving. It specifies seq_len = 131072 and discusses parallel function calls and external retrieval backends.

sources.title: Chat Completions
sources.evidence: The Toast 1 example and compatibility documentation support text conversations and function tools. The exact-model reasoning section says it has no thinking channel; reasoning_content is always null and reasoning-token usage is zero.

sources.title: Terms & Conditions
sources.evidence: The API service terms grant limited, revocable access, reserve service intellectual property and restrict extraction of underlying API structure. These support a proprietary service-license classification, not an open weight license.

sources.title: Mixedbread official public Hugging Face model inventory
sources.evidence: The live inventory returned twelve public Mixedbread checkpoints, consisting of embedding, reranking, and ColBERT models; no Toast 1 checkpoint, configuration, or weight release was listed.

sources.title: Research
sources.evidence: The current first-party research index links the Toast 1 launch article and papers about other retrieval models. No later Toast 1 technical report, model architecture disclosure, or total/active parameter table was located there.

sources.title: toast-harness
sources.evidence: The official repository publishes the retrieval harness and API examples under Apache-2.0. The model-generation backend is supplied separately; the public code does not distribute Toast 1 weights or disclose its neural architecture or count. Its harness license is not a Toast 1 weight license.

sources.title: BrowseComp-Plus benchmark · Toast 1
sources.evidence: This exact-model comparison reports retrieval quality, cost, latency, and default versus RRF configurations. Its table does not report production model parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.evidence: The August 13, 2026 entry explicitly records the Toast 1 release. Later entries describe hosted tools and context management as API features, not new model releases.

name.note: The official display name has a space; its API identifier is toast-1.

developer.note: The original announcement identifies Toast 1 as Mixedbread's model.

family.note: No separate model family or underlying backbone is identified in the reviewed primary material.

release_date.note: The dated announcement says it is available that day, independently corroborated by the release changelog.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is the hosted API under proprietary service terms. No public Toast checkpoint appears in the official model inventory; the released harness is separate software, not weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under Mixedbread's service license. Apache-2.0 applies to toast-harness, not to undistributed Toast 1 weights.

parameters_b.note: No nominal size or exact total parameter count is disclosed in the reviewed announcement, current card, research index, harness, or exact-model comparison. No later first-party count was located.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-parameter count or routing specification is disclosed. No equality with total parameters is inferred.

architecture.note: The sources describe a trained search agent and retrieval harness, not its neural backbone or dense/MoE structure. First-party research and public code did not identify an exact Toast 1 architecture.

context_window.note: The exact seq_len of 131072 refines the model card's rounded 131K label and replaces the catalog's 131000 approximation. This is the served sequence limit.

modalities.note: The exact-model card specifies text in and text out. Store ingestion and retrieval over media are service features and do not establish native multimodal inputs.

reasoning.note: Explicit exact-model evidence: the guide states training and serving are without thinking, and the API docs say Toast 1 has no thinking channel. This describes dedicated thinking support, not inability to reason in ordinary text.

tool_call.note: The model accepts custom function schemas and returns function calls; hosted retrieval execution is a separate API facility.

description.value: Specialized search model for knowledge-intensive questions, multi-step retrieval, and evidence synthesis
description.note: Supported directly by the model card and launch description; no unsupported benchmark superiority or architectural claim is retained.

patch.notes: Toast 1 is documented as a hosted proprietary model. Its Apache-2.0 retrieval harness is separately published software, not a weight release. The exact served context is 131,072 tokens. Mixedbread explicitly says Toast 1 was trained and is served without thinking. Total and active parameter counts, underlying architecture, and a separate model-family designation remain undisclosed in the reviewed primary sources.

sources.label: Toast 1 exact context and thinking policy

summary: Corrects context_window from 131000 to the explicit 131072-token serving limit and adds a proprietary service-license classification. Confirms release date, name, developer, closed weights, text modalities, function calling, description, and dedicated-reasoning=false using exact primary sources. Family, total/active parameters, and neural architecture remain undisclosed; no sibling or harness specifications are transferred.
